long_biography.plain_text:
The feed store founded by Blaine Phillips's grandfather Ralph supplied Pennsylvania farmers before the family saw a new market in suburban pet ownership. Blaine joined the business in 1981, following his father LaVern into its leadership. He shifted its emphasis towards pet food distribution, building a network of warehouses, retailer relationships and acquired regional distributors.

Phillips led the company as chief executive until 2016 and later returned to that role. He then moved to executive chairman, remaining involved in strategy and supplier relationships while retaining a substantial personal investment. The company is now controlled by Axar Capital, and Blaine's stake is distinct from outright control.
